name: NAME-KEPT-the-old-law
old: if (tier !== 'legendary') item.name = linesName(item.name, tier, was, item.affixes);
new: if (tier !== 'legendary') item.name = rarityName(item, tier, item.affixes.filter((a) => a?.gem == null));
note: the reforge names the piece again from its template, as before

name: NAME-KEPT-prefix-unchecked
old: if (pre != null) { if (!base.startsWith(`${pre} `)) return null; base = base.slice(pre.length + 1); }
note: a name without the lines' prefix read as the ladder's

name: NAME-KEPT-suffix-unchecked
old: if (suf != null) { if (!base.endsWith(` ${suf}`)) return null; base = base.slice(0, base.length - suf.length - 1); }
new: if (suf != null) { base = base.slice(0, base.length - suf.length - 1); }
note: a name without the lines' suffix read as the ladder's

name: NAME-KEPT-prefix-cut-short
note: the prefix's space left on the rest of the name

name: NAME-KEPT-gem-read-out
old: const base = nameBase(name, tier, was) ?? nameBase(name, tier, own(was));
note: an older reforge's gem word read as part of the name

name: NAME-KEPT-own-read-out
old: const base = nameBase(name, tier, was) ?? nameBase(name, tier, own(was));
note: a name of the law now beside a gem's line read as no line's

name: NAME-KEPT-gem-word-back
old: return base == null ? name : nameAround(base, tier, own(now));
new: return base == null ? name : nameAround(base, tier, now);
note: a set gem's word names the piece again (AUDIT GEM)

name: NAME-KEPT-own-name-lost
old: return base == null ? name : nameAround(base, tier, own(now));
new: return base == null ? rarityName({ templateIndex: -1, name }, tier, own(now)) : nameAround(base, tier, own(now));
note: a name no line gave is built around anyway
